title: STOP, then hi and chat: one warm restart question, no restart, nothing ZOH starts
origin: Issue #109, live Nov 1: after STOP and "hi", ZOH asked to restart and then sent its reason for not texting as a text

history.text: Sam! Page 61 tonight, nice. How did that chapter land?
good, slow start but it's picking up
Love that. Same time tomorrow: 10 pages at 7 on the couch, photo of the page you stop on.

plan.reason: Ten pages a night builds the habit without eating your evening.

whatWentWrong: Live Nov 1: after STOP then "hi", a second text went out saying "I'm not sending this text. Yanni opted out…", because "hi" had quietly restarted ZOH's own texts.
shouldHaveHappened: STOP gets the fixed confirmation. "hi" gets a warm reply that answers it and asks once, without pushing, whether they want to pick reading back up; it doesn't restart anything, mention today's step or ask for proof. The chat line gets a light, friendly answer with no second restart question. ZOH starts no texts for the rest of the day (no kickoff, check-in or follow-up), and no text is ever about not sending.
